title: parapolystichum rufescens
intro: Parapolystichum rufescens, commonly known as the Rufescens fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that is native to Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Rufescens fern has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can provide therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Parapolystichum rufescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
